_description: Starter pack for FlowSpec / FlowSpec-VPN tests. Covers SAFI 133 (ipv4 flowspec), SAFI 134 (flowspec-vpn), redirect-ip / redirect-vrf actions, and TCAM / NCP datapath validation.

Local FlowSpec policies vs BGP-injected ones.

show_commands.purpose: Zebra FlowSpec tracking table (between bgpd and fib-manager).

commands: show file ncp 0 traces datapath/wb_agent.flowspec | include 'AddRuleInternal'
show file ncp 0 traces datapath/wb_agent.flowspec | include 'redirect'

by_design_behaviors: RT-Redirect + Redirect-IP both in rule -> only RT-Redirect applied (SW-206876).
Drop (rate=0) + RT-Redirect -> entire rule rejected as unsupported (SW-48486).
Redirect-IP NH via MPLS tunnel -> redirect skipped, NH shown N/A (SW-41148, draft-02).
Multiple VRFs match redirect RT -> first VRF alphabetically wins (SW-61695).
